identitySignals: Archived copy (Jan 2026) of the company's own internship page says paid summer internships are open to students in the Oakland Unified School District (OUSD) Exploring College, Career and Community Options (ECCCO) program, matching the agenda's ECCCO Student Internship Program MOU

Same page names the business 'Inspire Behavioral Learning, LLC' and says interns tutor children in Oakland, Berkeley and nearby East Bay cities, matching the agenda's Oakland, CA location and 'Classroom & academic programs' category

The company's current website, inspireactivelearning.com, is branded 'Inspire Active Learning, LLC' but its 'What is ABA' page still refers to 'Inspire Behavioral Learning, LLC'; a Nextdoor business page also lists Inspire Behavioral Learning, LLC as the former name, so the two names are the same business
Agenda spelling 'Inspired Behavioral Learning' differs by one letter from the company's 'Inspire Behavioral Learning'; treated as a typo in the agenda
research.notes: Company rebranded from Inspire Behavioral Learning, LLC (old site inspirebehavior.com, now offline) to Inspire Active Learning, LLC. The OUSD/ECCCO link comes from an archived copy of the old site. The company serves Oakland, Berkeley and other Bay Area cities; no street address is published on the current site and the old Oakland phone (510-296-5519) is no longer current, so it is omitted. No registry IDs found; California Secretary of State was not checked (bizfile is not fetchable). Headquarters left blank: the old contact page lists Oakland but the Nextdoor listing shows Berkeley.

profile.summary: A Bay Area education company that offers tutoring in English, English as a Second Language, executive function skills and multiple elementary subjects, plus outdoor nature camps for young children. It also offers behavior therapy services based on applied behavior analysis. It was previously named Inspire Behavioral Learning, LLC, and it takes high school interns, including students from Oakland Unified's ECCCO program.

review.notes: Identity is confirmed: the archived inspirebehavior.com internship page names OUSD's ECCCO program, and the current site and Nextdoor tie Inspire Behavioral Learning, LLC to Inspire Active Learning, LLC. The summary claims the company 'offers behavior therapy services based on applied behavior analysis', but no cited source shows this: the current site lists tutoring, camps and BCBA supervision, and its ABA page says ABA is not limited to therapy. The summary needs rewriting without that claim before publication.
